detail.longDescription:
I benchmarked bb.py against plain python files, and against "architects and workers", the results sounds funnily relatable:

> What it shows. One agent writing through bb.py builds about as well as one writing a file, a little faster, with fewer output tokens but more re-reading. Splitting the work among an architect and workers costs much more and did worse. And the tools that should give agents a map of the code went almost unused.
